scripts.dev: npm run prepare:site && node scripts/astro.mjs dev
scripts.prepare:site: node scripts/python.mjs scripts/restore_snapshot.py && node scripts/python.mjs scripts/review.py apply && node scripts/assets.mjs
scripts.build: npm run prepare:site && node scripts/astro.mjs build && node scripts/python.mjs scripts/check_site.py
scripts.data:refresh: node scripts/python.mjs -m pipeline.build --refresh && node scripts/python.mjs scripts/review.py apply
scripts.check: node scripts/python.mjs scripts/restore_snapshot.py && node scripts/astro.mjs check
